# Third-Party Software

## GaitPart

Primary paper:

Fan et al.,
"GaitPart: Temporal Part-Based Model for Gait Recognition,"
CVPR 2020.

Original repository:

https://github.com/ChaoFan96/GaitPart

The original repository directs users to OpenGait for the complete
GaitPart implementation.

Repository:

The exact commit is recorded so that later changes to OpenGait do not
change the Project 2 reproduction environment.
